rationale: Official Gazette archive is the legally mandated, date-stamped venue for every regulator appointment act; failed URL is a soft signal only.
Central bank newsroom is a continuously producing primary feed for governor/council and senior-management changes.
Single incumbent page on nbrm.mk; useful as a diff target but covered by monitoring the NBRNM roster/newsroom parent.
Council roster is the best structured view of top supervisory personnel with predictable 7-year mandate expiries.
Org chart diffs reveal creation/renaming of payment-systems and supervision units before personnel news.
Regulator's own vacancy stream is the most direct A5 jobs signal and shows which capabilities are being built.
Assembly portal is the legal appointing body's own record of sessions and appointment decisions; verified live.
Appointments committee agenda is a 1-3 week leading indicator ahead of plenary votes; distinct recurring feed.
Specific vlada.mk oglas node — highest-value early vacancy signal but a section of the government portal already monitored.
Government session decision stream names appointees and proposals to the Assembly; durable standalone feed.
Securities Commission roster/org structure is a diffable Assembly-appointed leadership layer; verified public.
MoF Financial System Sector page names the banking-and-payments policy leads — directly in scope and diffable.
Civil-service vacancy portal carries the statutory job ads for MoF banking/payments units; core A5 jobs source.
Insurance supervisor's expert council uses the same Assembly appointment pipeline; known mandate-expiry anchor.
Pension supervisor roster covers the same appointment pipeline and cross-agency personnel rotation.
Deposit Insurance Fund staff page is a rare named mid-management roster in the bank safety-net cluster.
National Payment Systems Council membership maps payments authority across NBRNM, MoF, banks and schemes.
Business daily reliably breaks regulator appointments ahead of the official act; good early-warning tripwire.
State agency publishes advance notices of Assembly committee sessions; fetchable substitute when sobranie.mk blocks bots.
Standing tag archive on the appointments committee gives a continuous topical feed plus historical backfill.
Whole-market news aggregator; fastest sweep for appointment stories and snowballing to new outlets.
Non-authoritative but a useful one-off actor-map and succession-list scaffold with links back to primary acts.
Specialist central-banking trade publication is largely subscription-gated; valuable for English corroboration once access is cleared.
Statutory company register captures legally compelled management/board changes at banks, EMIs and payment institutions.
Free basic-profile lookup is the cheapest recurring way to detect signatory/manager changes at licensed entities.
Authoritative change-history certificate but issued as a paid/registered service; access must be cleared before routine use.
